about: Invented connection ends for matching an end to a kept item or place (memory/end_match.py `Ends.match`, with #4923's rule that a kept name in small letters is an end only whole; #4991). `kept`: the campaign's kept names. Each case: an end as a reader wrote it and the name it must match ('' for none). `must_not` ends must match nothing: a description opener, a word of a small-letter name, or a thing that isn't kept. Whether an item was lost, sold or given is the AI reader's `change`, never a set phrase, so it is not scored here.

must_not.why: a description of a thing that isn't kept
